`encrypted-non-latin.numbers` is the Numbers interoperability fixture from
[numbers-parser at 972e1cf](https://github.com/masaccio/numbers-parser/blob/972e1cf0cbcba0ec5178d8889b9b410542ebce2c/tests/data/encrypted-non-latin.numbers).
The test password is `秘密`, and the first table contains the value `Decryption`.
